{{Actor|name=ovl_En_Box}}

'''ovl_En_Box''' is the [[actor]] for the [[Treasure Chests|treasure chest]].

{{clear}}

== Notes ==
Chests use {{actor ref|0}}'s [[Ovl_player_actor/Get_Items#Get_Item_Table|Get Item Table]] to fetch what items are contained within. 

After obtaining [[Get Item]] 0x35 (Silver Gauntlets), the chest actor forces a sandstorm fade-out transition in order to load the cutscene depicting [[Nabooru]] being captured by [[Twinrova]] in the Desert Colossus. This can cause issues with graphics plugins due to the sandstorm fade-out depending on a specific [[object]] file.
